reviews.review:
Uninspiring, the picture of the upgrade tree doesnt match the one in game so I kept playing in hopes that there will be more stuff to make the game interesting. Instead you work your way through boring statincreas upgrades And figure out that the Prestige is meaningless as the rewards are only even more small barely noticable Upgrades for stats where many arent even Usefull to progress faster in the lategame.

4/10 it's basicly keep on mining with less interesting upgrade options
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you for enjoying my game for 8 hours! You played more than I expected people would. 

I'm sorry to hear you felt mislead by the screenshots, but the upgrade menu in-game is actually bigger than the screenshot!

The prestige system is not meant to convince you to keep playing, it is for people who want to start over but don't like deleting their save (in the settings menu)
